title: Azusawa Kohane — For A New Dawn〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hello.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hey, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Welcome, Kohane.
What can I get for you today?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Umm... Oh, can I have what I tried the other day? A cafe au lait with honey and cinnamon powder on top?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Coming right up.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Kohane, come sit with us!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Are you sure? Then, if you don't mind...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So, are you guys not practicing today?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: No, we are in a little bit.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But I decided to take a quick break since I had some time on my hands.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, okay!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hey, your school already had its opening ceremony, right?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, just the other day.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Then, you're officially a second-year now!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Have you noticed any changes? You're starting a new year with a new class and stuff, right?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Aside from those two things...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, the first-years. I have juniors now.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, right! They'll be looking up to you as their role model!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, but I'm not sure how much I'll be talking to them since I'm not in any clubs...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
But that's still really cool!
Do you think they're gonna call you by your last name or your first?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh...
Hehe. I'm not sure.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: During junior high school, I always felt a little anxious whenever my juniors called my name...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Really? But you're such a nice person, Kohane! I bet everyone's going to love you!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You think so? That'd be nice.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Can you tell us more about your school?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
I wanna know more too!
What else has changed for you?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
What else?
Uhh...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Settle down, you two.
I know you're happy to see her again, but you shouldn't badger her like that.

rows.Speaker: Len & Rin
rows.Line: We know!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Do you...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Anyway, Kohane, here's your cafe au lait.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Phew...
Your coffee always has this way of putting my mind at ease, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad to hear that.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Well?
Did you think of anything else that's changed now that you're a second-year?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Anything works!
For example, stuff that's different now compared to before!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Exactly!
You just mentioned what happened when you were in junior high! Tell us more about that!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Now compared to back then...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Come to think of it, I wasn't so afraid of walking into my new classroom...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Your new classroom?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, I always used to get really nervous whenever I was about to enter a new classroom for the first time...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Mostly because everyone looks at you for a second after you open the door...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I was afraid I wouldn't know what to say and worried I wouldn't be able to greet someone back if they tried to talk to me...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But this time, I didn't feel worried or afraid at all.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I always hesitated before, but I was able to say, “Good morning,” to everyone pretty naturally.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hey, that means you've grown a lot!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: In particular, your courage and confidence.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Otherwise, I doubt you would've been able to put on such a stellar performance as the opening act for your event.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! We're so proud of you, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I have started having a little more confidence in myself lately.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (But it's nice to hear others say that I've actually grown.)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So, can you tell us more?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, what else has happened?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, sure.
Anything in particular?
